fact: 1949年4月4日，美国、加拿大及10个西欧国家（英国、法国、比利时、荷兰、卢森堡、意大利、葡萄牙、丹麦、挪威、冰岛）在华盛顿签署《北大西洋公约》（华盛顿条约），北大西洋公约组织（NATO）正式成立。

sources.title: Founding treaty (NATO official)
sources.quote: The foundations of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) were officially laid down on 4 April 1949 with the signing of the North Atlantic Treaty, more popularly known as the Washington Treaty.

sources.title: North Atlantic Treaty (National Archives Museum, US)
sources.quote: On April 4, 1949, representatives of the United States, Canada, and 10 Western European nations met in Washington, DC, to sign a mutual defense pact against possible aggression from the Soviet Union.

fact: 1949年8月29日，苏联在哈萨克斯坦塞米巴拉金斯克试验场成功爆炸第一颗原子弹RDS-1（西方代号Joe-1），成为世界上第二个拥有核武器的国家。

sources.title: Испытание первой атомной бомбы в СССР (РИА Новости)
sources.quote: 29 августа 1949 года на Семипалатинском полигоне (Казахстан) прошли успешные испытания первого советского заряда для атомной бомбы.

sources.title: First Soviet Nuclear Bomb Test: How It Happened (Sputnik)
sources.quote: On 29 August 1949, the Soviet Union successfully tested its first atomic bomb, RDS-1.

fact: 1949年8月5日，美国国务院发表《美国与中国的关系》白皮书（Acheson White Paper），国务卿艾奇逊在致杜鲁门总统的信中称中国内战结果是美国政府无法控制的产物，标志着美国对华政策的公开转向。

sources.title: 毛泽东为什么要写《别了，司徒雷登》等评论?（中央党史和文献研究院）
sources.quote: 这部报告书（即白皮书）是当时的美国国务卿艾奇逊在征得了杜鲁门总统的同意后，组织国务院工作人员编纂的。全书包括正文八章，附件八章，外加收录在内的《艾奇逊致杜鲁门总统的信》及《中美关系大事纪年表》，共1054页，100多万字。

sources.title: What is the reason for saying that the US Government is responsible for the Taiwan question? (中华人民共和国驻奥克兰总领馆)
sources.quote: In his letter Acheson said: The unfortunate but inescapable fact is that the ominous result of the civil war in China was beyond the control of the government of the United States.

fact: 1949年杜鲁门签署《美国住房法》（Housing Act of 1949, P.L. 81-171），授权6年内新建81万套公共住房（每年13.5万套），并启动城市更新（Urban Renewal）项目，联邦政府承担净成本的三分之二。

sources.title: Introduction to Public Housing (Every CRS Report)
sources.quote: The Housing Act of 1949 (P.L. 81-171) created a federal policy goal of a decent home and suitable living environment for every American family. It authorized the Urban Renewal program.

sources.title: The Evolution of Low-Income Housing Policy (Advisory Center for Affordable Settlements & Housing)
sources.quote: They and their allies finally prevailed in 1949, when Congress authorized the construction of 810,000 units of public housing over the next six years.

fact: 1948年11月至1949年10月美国经历战后衰退（Post-War Recession），持续11个月；失业率从1948年的2.1百万（3%）升至1949年平均3.4百万（约5%），1949年7月达到峰值4.1百万。

sources.title: Economic Report of the President 1950 (FRASER, St. Louis Fed)
sources.quote: Over the year, unemployment averaged 3.4 million, or about 5 percent of the labor force, compared with 2.1 million or 3 percent of the somewhat smaller labor force in 1948. Unemployment at its worst in July 1949 amounted to 4.1 million.

sources.title: A History of U.S. Recessions (Self Financial)
sources.quote: November 1948 - October 1949: The Post-War Recession. Duration: 11 months.

fact: 1949年美国失业人口平均340万（约占劳动力5%），12月仍约350万，比1948年12月多160万；战后通胀在1948年秋见顶后回落，1949年处于价格调整与失业上升并存的阶段。

sources.title: Economic Report of the President 1950 (FRASER)
sources.quote: Unemployment at its worst in July 1949 amounted to 4.1 million. In December, it was just below 3.5 million, 1.6 million more than in December 1948.

sources.title: Flood Tide (FRASER, Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta)
sources.quote: The nation was almost immediately overwhelmed by a wave of prosperity that began to rise in 1946, reached its crest in the fall of 1948, and then subsided in a minor recession that ran on into the last half of 1949.

fact: 战后美国工业生产指数在1948年秋见顶后回落，1949年下半年进入温和衰退；但联邦储备委员会工业生产指数已从战时高点回落到1946年的170，1949年的衰退是战后调整的延续而非萧条重演。

sources.title: Flood Tide (FRASER, Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta)
sources.quote: The Federal Reserve index of industrial production that had fallen from its wartime high to 170 in 1946.

sources.title: The Mechanisms of the Business Cycle in the Postwar Era (NBER)
sources.quote: The business cycle has persisted in the postwar period, producing eight separate episodes of systematic fluctuations. Although a depression of the 1930s variety has been avoided, more severe and frequent recessions have occurred.

fact: 1949年住房法授权城市更新与公共住房建设，联邦政府承担净成本三分之二；这一法案与州际公路法案、GI法案一起构成战后美国建筑业与房地产开发的制度基础。

sources.title: Housing in the Seventies (HUD User)
sources.quote: The Housing Act of 1949, which was enacted with broad support from both political parties, contained the clearest statement to that time of a national commitment to housing.

sources.title: The Housing Act of 1949: An Ultimate Guide (US Law Explained)
sources.quote: The federal government would cover two-thirds of the net cost of this process. Title III authorized the construction of 810,000 new public housing units over a six-year period.
